* '''Original''' ([[BoShek, Gritty Smuggler]], 7 January 2019): Original: the image at the set's official release (8 January 2019). Players Committee card image, 7 January 2019: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-boshekgrittysmuggler-20190107.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/e0ebcbc/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/large/boshek.gif Holotable commit e0ebcbc “Set 10 images”], no mark). Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. BoShek's deploy cost may not be increased. During battle, may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny or cancel an attempt to cancel and redraw a destiny. Immune to attrition < 3.”
* '''PC-E1''' (this page, 19 August 2024): Players Committee card image, 19 August 2024: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-boshekgrittysmuggler-20240819.png]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/a20089e/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/boshek.png Holotable commit a20089e “Virtual Set 10 Remastered”], no mark). Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. BoShek's deploy cost may not be increased. During battle, may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny or cancel an attempt to cancel and redraw a destiny. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' Virtual Set 10 remaster: the card was re-rendered (745×1039, was 350×490); the title (“•BoShek”) and words are unchanged; no mark. Listed as its own version under Bill's rulings of 12 November 2026 (every visible change on a PC image is a version).
*: [[File:V10-L-boshekgrittysmuggler-20240819-changes.png|frameless|upright=2.6|alt=Before and after]] ''Before (left) and after (right): cropped from the published images.''
* '''PC-E2''' ([[BoShek, Gritty Smuggler (Errata 2)]], 29 December 2024): Players Committee card image, 29 December 2024: 0 side [[:File:V10-L-boshekgrittysmuggler.gif]] ([https://github.com/swccgpc/holotable/blob/efc26cd/Images-HT/starwars/Virtual10-Light/hires/boshek.png Holotable commit efc26cd “Set 24 Part 2 (Errata and fixes)”], mark “E1”). Text: “Adds 3 to power of anything he pilots. If you have completed a Kessel Run, your total power here is +2. Once during battle, may use 1 Force to choose: Subtract 1 from an opponent's just drawn destiny or cancel an attempt to cancel and redraw a destiny. Immune to attrition < 3.” '''What changed:''' title “•BoShek” became “•BoShek, Gritty Smuggler”; “BoShek's deploy cost may not be increased.” became “If you have completed a Kessel Run, your total power here is +2.”; “During battle, may use 1 Force to subtract 1 from opponent's just drawn destiny or …” became “Once during battle, may use 1 Force to choose: Subtract 1 from an opponent's just drawn destiny or …”. '''PC transcription error:''' the card prints the errata mark “E1”, but this is errata version 2 by release order (PC-E2); see [[Players Committee transcription errors]].
